comparison.objective: Square and tighten a sanitary tri-clamp joint, not set an adjustable stop.
comparison.physical_skill: Align a cocked clamp over two ferrules and draw it up with a wing nut.
comparison.success_condition: Clamp is square and seated on both ferrules before tightening; detailed tolerances are absent.
comparison.reason: It tests joint alignment and fastening, without preserving a separately calibrated value against a locknut.
